trigger: Untouched fusion challenge showed strong routing/semantic generalization but weak out-of-family summary preservation.
lesson: A learned contextualized representation and a lossless source representation are different contracts. Do not force one vector to satisfy both. Expose exact source anchors separately while allowing contextualized state to move freely.
general_rule: When a downstream module must both reinterpret and preserve upstream evidence, keep a non-destructive source channel alongside the learned transformed channel rather than over-weighting a reconstruction penalty.

trigger: Repair checkpoints were selected on repair-dev after a prior frozen challenge informed failure-driven work.
lesson: A new confirmatory challenge must evaluate a candidate selected before the challenge is observed. Do not evaluate many checkpoints and select the best on the same ratification set.
general_rule: Separate development selection from final confirmation: preselect one candidate on development evidence, freeze thresholds and test data, then perform one confirmatory decision.

trigger: Confirmatory coverage expanded to historical queries over superseded and temporal-successor records.
lesson: Superseded is not forgotten and newer is not always the answer. Query scope must control whether current or historical state is selected from the same evidence graph.
general_rule: Always include both latest-state and prior-state queries when validating temporal memory/evidence systems; otherwise a model can pass by learning recency bias instead of temporal reasoning.
